notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.75
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update focus is bug fixing, system improvements, and overall performance enhancements:



 Fixed a bug that was limiting tech tree options

 Fixed a UI bug related to the scroll function

 Fixed a minor bug related to crafting

 Fixed a bug related to AI movement

 Fixed a minor server networking bug that impacted performance for some players

 Fixed an async-related bug

 Fixed a minor buildable positioning bug

 Improved AI navigation system

 Improved overall performance

 Improved Nanite object load times

 Minor improvements to UI function performance


Hello again! I want to thank you all for your continued support and for playing Planetaries.

I’m currently working on a future major update, which will bring the game to newer technologies this might impact performance slightly but will also improve visuals and the overall experience.

What would you like to see in the future of Planetaries? Let me know!

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.71 - More Optimization
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update focuses on optimization and game stability. As we move forward, I continually seek out areas to optimize and improve, recognizing that many features are still experimental within the engine. Addressing certain optimization challenges requires unique solutions, especially for issues not yet resolved by the engine developers.

Here’s what’s new in this update:


 Mesh Streaming Performance increase.

 Major Rendering Performance increase.

 Improved Game Runtime Stability.

 Fixed game stability issues.

 Fixed engine-related stability issues.

 Fixed minor UI bugs.

 Fixed background tasks cleaning issues.

 Improved Random Events system.

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.70 - First Person
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! After a lot of intense work, I've successfully added an experimental First-Person view! This update brings not only this exciting new mode but also a lot of great tweaks and additions to enhance gameplay.

What's New:

 Added Experimental First Person View:
You can switch to first person by holding the camera key (default: "C").
Note: This is an experimental mode. It may have bugs, visual artifacts, and some animations may appear off since they weren't originally designed for first person. I hope to refine this over time as development progresses.

https://i.ibb.co/TkcfM2C/1.gif
https://i.ibb.co/QdVkh6P/3.gif

 Added Buildable Structure Repair Station:
This structure will repair nearby damaged structures within a radius and consume Nucleium as a resource.

Added New Item "Energized Battery"

Added New Buildable Machine "Nucleium Harvester" this machine can harvest Nucleium resources.

Added New Buildable Machine "Synthesizer" this machine can synthesize crystals.

Minor UI Improvements

Minor Performance Tweaks

Boss hatched creatures now have improved behavior and intelligence

Improved AI Movement System

NPCs will no longer target player vehicles if the player is not inside

Removed Halloween Holiday Music


Thank you for all the feedback and support that helps shape these updates! Your input is invaluable as I continue to improve the game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.68 - DLSS / FSR
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update is technical, focusing on adding Nvidia's and AMD's latest DLSS and FSR technology to Planetaries as well as Frame Generation. I've noticed some of you really want a First Person view. It will be considered.

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.66 - New Features
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! In this update, we say goodbye to the old tech tree and introduce a new one that contains more items overall and makes it easier to add content in the future. It’s more straightforward and user-friendly, especially for new players. Alongside this major change, I've also included a lot of improvements, fixes, and new features. 

Here’s a list of all the new stuff in this update:


Fixed a bug that caused TD waves to despawn if a bed was built close to their spawn points.

Fixed an issue causing some performance decreases.

Fixed a bug where the launch pad would work even if not placed.

Fixed the main menu Discord link.

Improved sitting for all chairs.

Improved and updated the loot system.

General AI improvements.

UI improvements and changes.

Changes and balancing to all ranged weapons.

Updated all vendors' trade lists.

Increased decay timer for corpses.

Added a new vehicle: HoverBike.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/4391a18ddc3cdd8aebc6350893a99f0370486d40.gif

Added a buildable Teleporter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/7fa15112f197d413d40debd178d155ad7a68d44b.gif

Added new consumables rarity.

Added new rarities to all ranged weapons.

Added energy maces, blades, and heavy swords to the crafting list.

Added new crafting recipes.

Added tooltips to some UI elements.

Added the first implementation of the new tech tree [Tech Data].

Player perk points have been separated into two types: Tech Data and Player Perks.

Added a multiplier setting for TD waves to make it harder and earn higher rewards.

Thank you all again for supporting the game and for being kind-hearted. I'm listening closely to your feedback, so please let me know if you like the new changes and the new "Tech Tree."

notes.content:

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix! Server Browser / Steam Invites
notes.content:
Thank you to all the players supporting Planetaries! 

I'm dedicated to making this game the greatest.
In this hotfix:

I've added a way to see your Steam friends' servers and an option in the player list tab to invite them to your server. 

 I've also fixed a bug where you couldn't rebind the Interaction Key and addressed minor performance issues. 


If you're an AMD user experiencing lag spikes or low FPS, consider reverting to an earlier driver version—this is related to Unreal Engine 5 and AMD drivers. 

Thanks again!

notes.title: Game Is Available Right Now!
notes.content:
Thank you to all the players who have wishlisted and patiently waited for the release of the game, and a warm welcome to all the new players joining us! 

Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable, and I'm listening closely. 

I'm excited to announce that Controller Support is already on its way! The future of the game is being actively worked on, with a ROAD MAP to be announced by the end of the month.

Thank you again for your incredible support!
